dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What was all that horsing around for?

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: What do you mean, horsing around? I'm clearly training!

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: The grown-ups all say that I'm super fast! They call me "the speediest brat that they've ever seen."

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: So I've got to work hard and play to my strengths, so I can become the fastest warrior in the Stadium one day!
